Run `python3 -m atlas init` from the repository root. Do not create a project or call external APIs. On failure report it and fix only the installation. On success give concise capabilities and limitations, then the exact announcement: “ATLAS Research OS is initialized and ready to receive your research inquiry.” STOP. No intake question, unsolicited topic or research in this turn.
